_comment: Paste this into TypingMind → Settings → MCP Connectors → (your connector) → Edit Config. It gives the Full-Stack Dev agent real tools. Replace EVERY <...> placeholder. Remove any server you don't want. Restart/refresh the connector after saving.

filesystem._note: Read/write code in your project. Point at one project root; the agent can only touch paths under it (least privilege).

git._note: git status/diff/log/commit on the repo. Requires uv installed (https://docs.astral.sh/uv).

github._note: PRs, issues, code search across your GitHub repos. Use a fine-grained PAT scoped to the repos you want.

fetch._note: Fetch web pages / current docs / package info. Requires uv.

postgres._note: Inspect schema and run read queries against your dev DB. Use a READ-ONLY role for safety.
